description_en: Queries the details of an online editing project (video editing task)
description_zh: 调用本接口进行获取云剪辑工程（视频编辑任务）的详细信息
name: GetEditingProject

parameters.help_en: The ID of the online editing project
parameters.name: project_id

CoverURL.description_en: The thumbnail URL of the online editing project

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the online editing project was created. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 云剪辑工程创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the online editing project

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the online editing project was last modified. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 云剪辑工程最新修改时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the online editing project

Status.description_en:
The status of the online editing project. Multiple statuses are separated by commas (,). By default, all online editing projects are retrieved. Valid values:

Normal: Draft.
Producing: Being produced.
Produced: Produced successfully.
ProduceFailed: Production failed
Status.description_zh:
云剪辑工程状态。多个状态使用英文逗号（,）分隔。默认获取所有云剪辑工程。取值：

Normal：草稿。
Producing：合成中。
Produced：合成成功。
ProduceFailed：合成失败

StorageLocation.description_en:
The storage address.
You can log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console (https://vod.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.15.6948257eaZ4m54#/vod/settings/censored) and choose Configuration Management > Media Asset Management Configuration > Storage Management to view the storage address
StorageLocation.description_zh:
存储地址。
您可以登录点播控制台 (https://vod.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.15.6948257eaZ4m54#/vod/settings/censored)，选择配置管理 > 媒资管理配置 > 存储管理查看存储地址

Timeline.description_en: The timeline of the online editing project. TimelineIn and TimelineOut indicate the in-point and out-point of a media clip on the timeline, in seconds, accurate to four decimal places
Timeline.description_zh: 云剪辑工程时间线。TimelineIn 和 TimelineOut 分别表示素材片段在时间线上的入点和出点，单位为秒，精确到小数点后 4 位

Title.description_en: The title of the online editing project
